parts:
I've been trying to search the list and the manual for options in =
setting up
Distance to calculate density for individual points. I've come
tantalizingly close but I still can't figure out how the file sets up. =
I
have historic survey information on a 1-mile grid and I want to =
calculate
tree density at each point (n=3D~2,000 and 20K records) with a point =
having
anywhere from 1 spp/record to several spps/records. Can anyone walk me
through or send me an example file of how this sets up? I can get it =
to
give me overall density for the whole region, but I keep getting an =
error
that "The number of observations is -1 is less than the number of key ||
parameters 1. No fit possible." I did a similar process 10yr ago, but
distance has evolved since then and I'm at a loss of how to set this up.
